summary.text: Contented Lifestyle is an immortal killer move named when paintings of mortal lives surface across Emperor City.

claims.text: An Earth Trench approaches Emperor City. Divine Bean Palace turns into jade light, flies into the sky, and lands at the city’s center. Green light covers Emperor City. Paintings of the lives of people surface in every corner, showing the city at certain points in time: markets, courtyards, a marriage procession, a teahouse, a fortune teller at dusk. The contented lifestyles of the people in Emperor City can be seen in these paintings. This is a painting path method filled with the profundities of human path. Immortal killer move Contented Lifestyle is named. Central Continent Gu Immortals ask whether Emperor City has such a hidden method from Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable.

Mortals cheer and kowtow to the paintings. New paintings appear of those kowtowing people. The killer move draws power from mortals to strengthen itself. That power is transmitted into Divine Bean Palace, and Genesis Lotus’ will controls it. Hong Yi and Ye Fan are sealed inside a painting created by the killer move. They see a peaceful and serene environment.

Lu Wei Yin tells Ye Fan that when Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable returned to Central Continent, he used the painting path killer move contented lifestyle on Emperor City, forming a painting world. The Genesis Lotus true inheritance is divided into three parts. The first part is this contented lifestyle killer move.

Xiao Qi Xing tells Chen Da Jiang that the painting world is so vivid because it is the effect of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable’s contented lifestyle killer move. Gu Masters nominated by their sects are sent here. Gu Masters cultivating here cultivate mainly human path.

Divine Emperor City contains painting worlds. This is Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable’s contented lifestyle killer move. It is a human path killer move with painting path effect that formed paintings of the lives of people. It is a rank nine level venerable killer move.
Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable left behind the killer move contented lifestyle. He was active before Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.
